answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 156892 Country: US Title: If Muslim Stores have halal sign, is it okay to eat from there as in if they say they are halal but are not in actuality yet we are unaware of that since they claim to be? Question: If Muslim Stores have halal sign, is it okay to eat from there as in if they say they are halal but are not in actuality yet we are unaware of that since they claim to be? Answer ID: 156892 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 259/181/Sd=3/1439) If the shop belongs to a Muslim and he has assured you of halal, then you should not have any doubt merely on the basis of suspicion. You may consume it. However, if you have strong doubts then it is better to confirm it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
